entries.137334598163f839: The company is an automotive parts manufacturer headquartered in Utsunomiya, Tochigi Prefecture. It was established in 1958 as Muro Kinzoku Kogyo Co., Ltd., has 12 consolidated subsidiaries and one affiliated company, and had 1,061 consolidated employees as of March 31, 2026. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

entries.241f5cd3aafe8381: In the Metal-Related Parts Business, the basic strategy is further penetration of existing customers, and the priority issue is strengthening response in product areas centered on electrified vehicles, including EVs, and others; the company says it aims for “manufacturing that customers truly need,” with emphasis on technology development. In the Resin-Related Parts Business, the company says it is expanding sales not only of standalone resin parts but also of composite resin-metal parts, aiming to grow them into a new pillar of the business. In the Other Business, the basic strategy is expanding sales of existing products in global markets, and for overseas bases the company says it is strengthening direct sales to North America and Asia.

entries.d8bf2812a3d9444a: The source of competitiveness in the Metal-Related Parts Business lies in its high capability to realize products and to mass-produce them; because its strengths cannot be exerted in products that can be easily shaped and quickly mass-produced as good products, the company positions itself as competitive in high-difficulty and high-value-added parts. In addition, dealing with a variety of customers is a factor that moderates performance fluctuations caused by the circumstances of individual customers. Production bases are spread across Japan as well as the United States, Vietnam, Indonesia, China and Thailand.
